newsitem.title: UK: India's Finmin wants deficit at 4.0 pct in 4 yrs.
newsitem.headline: India's Finmin wants deficit at 4.0 pct in 4 yrs.

text.p: India's Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said he wanted India's fiscal deficit at four percent of GDP in four years from a target of five percent in 1996/97, he told a press conference.
"I want the fiscal deficit at four percent in four years, although I do have a term of five years to achieve it," Chidambaram said on Thursday.
The minister said that he was adhering to his target of 6.5 percent growth in the Indian economy for the current 1996/97 year.
"Last year the agricultural sector grew very slowly, just 2.1 percent, this year the monsoon was very good and indications are we will have a record year," Chidambaram said.
He refused to comment on whether India would set official limits on government borrowing.

"The Reserve (central) Bank governor discussed this idea, but this is a very complex area, it is not my job as finance minister to give an off-the-cuff answer," Chidambaram said. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
